instruction: Go to https://www.postgresql.org/ and create a document called "postgres_features.docx" on the desktop. List at least 3 features or benefits of PostgreSQL using a numbered list format.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires visiting a website, creating a docx document, and formatting content as a numbered list with at least 3 items. Evaluator checks if the document contains at least 3 numbered list items.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly checks for numbered lists using XML API to detect <w:numPr> elements in paragraph properties (lines 36-40)
The detection method properly checks 'para._element.pPr.find(numPr)' which is the correct way to identify actual numbering formatting
Includes fallback regex check for plain text numbered markers (lines 42-46) which adds robustness
Metric correctly accesses expected parameters: 'expected.get("requires_numbering")' and 'expected.get("min_numbers")' - properly handles the rules dict passed by get_rule()
Comparison logic is semantically correct: checks if numbering_count >= min_numbers (3)
Postconfig appropriately saves the document with Ctrl+S before evaluation to ensure file is written to disk
Complete coverage: evaluator checks the main requirement (at least 3 numbered list items) as specified in the instruction
